title: Lion Dance Team Teammate
setting: The child learns lion dance at a community association and chats with a teammate about drum patterns and the next performance. They live in the same estate.

title: Cheerleading Squad Alumni
setting: The child is on a school cheer squad and an alumna sometimes coaches them. The DM is about practice before inter-school competition.

title: Voice Acting Practice Group
setting: The child is in an online voice acting hobby group that records fan dubs. A fellow member asked to rehearse a scene together.

title: Former Primary School Classmate
setting: The child's former primary school classmate, who moved to another district, followed them again. The chat is about catching up on old friends.

title: Sibling's Friend Messaging
setting: The child's older brother's friend, who visits the flat sometimes, found the child on Instagram and sent a message. The thread begins as friendly chat about school and games.
